decisions.reason: The request for copyright-process guidance does not change the existing KDP metadata, upload, delivery-mode, or submission-support requirements.
Copyright-process guidance does not change the paperback cover's content, presentation, deliverable, or production responsibility.
The client asks about a copyright process comparable to obtaining an ISBN, not about changing the copyright page's content, alignment, email, or website presentation.
The publishing-process question does not modify the manuscript's editorial objective or any approved prose.
The copyright-process question has no effect on chapter-image suitability, mapping, selection, or review criteria.
No chapter-heading hierarchy, capitalization, or subtitle-formatting rule is changed by the copyright-process question.
Copyright guidance does not alter image aspect-ratio, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The source decision does not change whether, when, or where chapter images are placed.
The copyright-process question does not change the required italic styling for the Mama's Hot Take text.
No page-density or paragraph-spacing behavior is affected by the request for copyright guidance.
The source message does not identify a new authoritative manuscript revision or change any content that must be integrated.
The copyright-process question does not change the title page or the rule excluding the literal newline artifact.
